definitions.explanation: People related by blood or marriage. A somewhat formal term that encompasses a broader range of family connections than immediate family, including extended relatives such as cousins, aunts, uncles, and in-laws.

examples.japanese: {親族|しんぞく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{親族|しんぞく}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招待|しょうたい}した→招待する：01833_shoutaisuru⟧。
examples.english: We invited only relatives to the wedding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遠|とお}い→遠い：00529_tooi⟧{親族|しんぞく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised to receive a sudden contact from a distant relative.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {親族|しんぞく}{関係|かんけい}: family/kinship relations
- {親族|しんぞく}⟦{一同|いちどう}→一同：08918_ichidou⟧: all the relatives
- ⟦{遠|とお}い→遠い：00529_tooi⟧{親族|しんぞく}: distant relative
- ⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧{親族|しんぞく}: close relative
- {親族|しんぞく}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧: family council

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧: relatives (more colloquial and commonly used in daily conversation)
- ⟦{身内|みうち}→身内：14300_miuchi⟧: family, one's own people (informal, includes close associates)
- ⟦{一族|いちぞく}→一族：11229_ichizoku⟧: clan, whole family (emphasizes the group as a unit)

USAGE:
{親族|しんぞく} is more formal than ⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧ and is preferred in legal, official, and ceremonial contexts such as funerals, weddings, and legal documents. In casual conversation, ⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧ is more natural.
